title: UUID v4 Generator
description: Generate random UUID v4 identifiers instantly. Free, fast, and works offline — RFC 4122 compliant.

faq.a: A UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) is a 128-bit identifier that is unique across space and time. UUID v4 is randomly generated.
The probability of generating two identical UUID v4 values is astronomically low — approximately 1 in 2^122.

faq.q: Can I use UUIDs as database primary keys?
faq.a: Yes, UUIDs are commonly used as primary keys in distributed systems where auto-incrementing IDs are not practical.
